test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in positive degree of comparison.**

He was greater than any other physiologist of the century.

options.text: All other physiologists were as great as him.
He was the greatest physiologist of all.
He as a physiologist in the country was among the greatest people.
No other physiologist of the century was as great as he was.

solution:
The correct answer is **"No other physiologist of the century was as great as he was."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in a comparative degree, comparing the greatness of the mentioned physiologist to all other physiologists of the century.
 
• To convert it to a positive degree, we need to state that the mentioned physiologist was the greatest of all.
 
• The correct option, Option 4, does this by stating that no other physiologist of the century was as great as he was.
 
• Option 1 is incorrect as it states that all other physiologists were as great as him, which is not the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• Option 2 is the correct positive degree form, but it is not an exact rephrasing of the given sentence, which makes it less suitable than Option 4.
 
• Option 3 is incorrect as it narrows down the comparison to only the country, while the original sentence compares the mentioned physiologist to all other physiologists of the century.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *No other physiologist of the century was as great as he was.*
